Introduction

Jin Hyeon-ju, formerly known under the stagenames Belle and Lucky, is a Filipino-Korean singer signed to J9 Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group cignature until their disbandment in 2024, as well as a member of the girl group GOOD DAY and their Morning sub-unit until their disbandment in 2019. She is well-known for her appearances on the survival shows, 'The Unit', and 'Universe Ticket'. She made it to the final lineup of UNIS.
